seo.title: Industry Solutions | openIndu Full-Stack Platform
seo.description: Display panels, semiconductors and new energy: where openIndu's full stack plugs into each end-to-end process chain — PLC control, machine vision, edge computing and craftsmanship knowledge.

hero.title: Industry Scenarios
hero.subtitle: Display panels, semiconductors and new energy — where the openIndu stack plugs into each step of the chain

panel.problem: Substrate identity and carrier binding break easily; alignment-exposure and colour-filter pattern defects rely on manual re-inspection; Cell/Module anomalies are hard to trace back to a specific step.
panel.hardware: A soft PLC on domestic industrial silicon drives loading, cleaning and lamination takt, with anti-collision interlocks on the robot arms.
panel.vision: openIndu-vision uses OpenCV for surface particles/scratches, pattern breaks and pinholes, and lit-panel appearance judgement.
panel.data: openIndu-cim + platform bind Glass ID, carrier ID and process route, retaining cleaning and exposure program versions.
panel.craftsmanship: The forum's panel column collects field practice and defect back-tracing for the TFT-LCD / OLED chains.
panel.whyWorks: Design once, generate PLC programs across brands; vision verdicts feed straight back into the PLC loop; step identity stays traceable across the whole chain.

semiconductor.problem: Wafer identity and route-admission checks are scattered across tools; recipe versions and SPC rules are hard to unify; defect maps cannot effectively drive back-end sorting.
semiconductor.hardware: Domestic industrial silicon handles transport and tool interlocking, gating admission on prerequisites and SPC rules.
semiconductor.vision: openIndu-vision joins appearance and defect re-inspection, emitting coordinates and layer information.
semiconductor.data: openIndu-cim makes fast verdicts at the edge; platform aggregates wafer ID / FOUP / recipe version and metrology values.
semiconductor.craftsmanship: The forum's semiconductor column records interface conventions and traceability fields for the wafer-to-package chain.
semiconductor.whyWorks: Release/rework/scrap decisions share one data basis; edge verdicts need no cloud round trip; metrology and defects trace back to a specific chamber and lot.

newEnergy.problem: Material-lot identity is hard to guarantee before mixing; cell identity easily decouples from formation and grading curves; EOL data in the module/PACK stage is incomplete.
newEnergy.hardware: Domestic industrial silicon controls coating, assembly and formation-cabinet takt, coordinating multi-brand equipment.
newEnergy.vision: openIndu-vision inspects electrode alignment, weld spots and module appearance (including PV EL images).
newEnergy.data: openIndu-cim + platform bind material lot — cell identity — test curve, carried through to PACK and EOL.
newEnergy.craftsmanship: The forum's new-energy column records process parameters and anomaly handling for the lithium-battery and PV-module chains.
newEnergy.whyWorks: The identity chain from material to finished goods never breaks; curve data maps one-to-one to each cell; a single stack covers both the lithium-battery and PV chains.

whyEffective.heading: Why the openIndu Stack Works
whyEffective.subheading: Conventional setups are fragmented: the vision system stands alone, the PLC stands alone, the data system stands alone. openIndu solves that with one integrated four-layer design.

items.title: One design, cross-brand output
items.description: Design once in openIndu-studio and generate code for Siemens, Mitsubishi, Inovance and other PLC vendors — less duplicated work, lower maintenance cost.

items.title: Vision and control, natively integrated
items.description: openIndu-vision is built into studio, so there is no manual system integration. Inspection results feed the PLC control loop in real time.

items.title: Parameter changes take effect live
items.description: Changing a process parameter needs no recompile and no firmware download. Edit it in platform and it reaches the line in seconds.

items.title: Full-stack, data-driven optimisation
items.description: A complete data path from hardware → vision → parameters → craftsmanship. Diagnosis shifts from on-site debugging to remote data analysis.

items.title: A crowdsourced parameter library
items.description: The forum's craftsmanship library gathers industry best practice, so new projects reuse proven parameters instead of starting from zero.

items.title: Built for engineers
items.description: No complex commercial SaaS pricing. Fully open source — deploy on-premise, stay in control, extend freely.
